options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --config CONFIG       Path to remote_train.yaml
  --provider {mock,vastai}
                        Compute provider
  --gpu GPU             GPU name substring filter (e.g. A100)
  --min-vram MIN_VRAM   Minimum GPU VRAM in GB
  --disk DISK           Minimum/requested disk in GB (must hold model weights)
  --max-price MAX_PRICE
                        Max $/hr cap
  --max-hours MAX_HOURS
                        Max wall-clock hours (teardown watchdog)
  --verbose             Debug logging
  --notify              Telegram ping on completion.
  --model MODELS        Model id to evaluate (repeatable, e.g.
                        Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B-Base).
  --benchmark {screenspot}
                        Which eval to run.
  --limit LIMIT         Cap samples (omit = full dataset).
  --dataset DATASET     Override the benchmark's default HF dataset.
  --split SPLIT         Override the dataset split.
  --coord-space {normalized_1000,viewport_abs,native_abs}
                        Coordinate convention THE MODEL answers in.
                        normalized_1000 for a stock Qwen; viewport_abs for a
                        checkpoint fine-tuned on this corpus.
